mapper.select: SELECT id, initiation_id, period, contract_amount, recognized_revenue, billed_amount, received_amount, labor_cost, purchase_cost, expense_cost, outsource_cost, allocation_cost, total_cost, gross_profit, gross_margin, progress_pct, billable_hours, non_billable_hours, snapshot_at, tenant_id, provider_trace_id, deleted FROM pmis_profit_snapshot WHERE initiation_id = #{initiationId} AND period = #{period} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT id, initiation_id, period, contract_amount, recognized_revenue, billed_amount, received_amount, labor_cost, purchase_cost, expense_cost, outsource_cost, allocation_cost, total_cost, gross_profit, gross_margin, progress_pct, billable_hours, non_billable_hours, snapshot_at, tenant_id, provider_trace_id, deleted FROM pmis_profit_snapshot WHERE initiation_id = #{initiationId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY period DESC
SELECT period, total_cost, gross_profit, gross_margin, progress_pct FROM pmis_profit_snapshot WHERE initiation_id = #{initiationId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY period ASC
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(gross_profit), 0) FROM pmis_profit_snapshot WHERE deleted = 0
